newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac, Kohl held lengthy telephone conversation.
newsitem.headline: Chirac, Kohl held lengthy telephone conversation.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac and German Chancellor Helmut Kohl held a lengthy telephone conversation following France's parliamentary election, a spokeswoman for Chirac said on Monday.
She said the telephone conversation had been at Kohl's initiative, but gave no further details.

The two leaders, who meet frequently, are due to hold their next regular talks in the French town of Poitiers on June 13, three days before a European Union summit due to approve a reform of the 15-nation bloc's institutions.

France's combined left ousted the ruling centre-right coalition in the parliamentary election on Sunday, forcing Chirac into a period of "cohabitation" -- power sharing between a president and government from different political parties.
The left said during the campaign it would refuse further austerity measures if they were required to qualify France for a single European currency in 1999.
